review:
Sugar Rush Super Scatter brings Super Scatters to the Sugar Rush cluster game. Winning symbols explode and mark their spot; another explosion on that spot in the same tumble sequence adds a 2x multiplier that doubles each time, up to 1,024x, and several multipliers in one win are added together.

Three or more scatters, or a mix of scatters and Super Scatters, trigger up to 30 free spins where the marked multipliers stay in place. Pragmatic says wins can reach 50,000x when at least one Super Scatter helps trigger the bonus. Published RTP is 96.58%. It suits players who like the original and want a higher ceiling.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
